aha: Every monster has a weapon waiting above it: step out of a notch to drop the pearl on the crab and a stone on the piranha (plugging its pit), and a stone down the jellyfish shaft (plugging its bottom). Then dig the deep road and collect the air before any pearl goes down the shaft.
deadlocks: Pushing a pearl into the jellyfish shaft before the stone: it falls into the bottom pit and is lost.
Dropping a pearl down the shaft before the deep road (and the air capsule on it) is cleared: the pearl blocks the only way through, so the road can never be dug.
Missing the crab or the piranha with the drop: the monster stays alive in the pearl lane, or the piranha room loses its pit plug.
Dropping the right pearl while the piranha lives on the gate side: the diver cannot get in behind it.
timing: crab crush from the notch 23% -> 47% (crab den shortened to x=2..4, sand at x=1 and x=5..6); jelly 83%, piranha 48% unchanged
